verdict.rationale: Marqeta's sandbox explicitly supports simulating card network transactions including authorizations, reversals, and balance inquiries, with a guided quick-start tutorial to simulate transactions before going live (marqeta-docs-10, marqeta-docs-14, marqeta-docs-20). However, the evidence does not explicitly confirm simulation of clearings, refunds, or declines as part of this same simulation endpoint set. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of clearing/settlement simulation, refund simulation, and decline-scenario simulation, plus any independent/hands-on confirmation of full lifecycle coverage.
